newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia says invests in U.S. Ipsilon.
newsitem.headline: Nokia says invests in U.S. Ipsilon.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it had made a minority investment in Ipsilon Networks Inc of the United States, a maker of internet protocol (IP) switches.
Nokia said it had agreed with Ipsilon to cooperate in developing broadband technology and had "made a minority investment in Ipsilon."
It did not give the value or any other details of the investment.
The cooperation between Nokia and Ipsilon would focus particularly on traffic and cost optimisation in future broadband services networks for multimedia, Nokia said.

"Nokia also intends to pursue similar activities with other existing and new technology partners to speed up the development of broadband technologies targeted for telecommunications service providers," it said, but did not elaborate.
